queries.name: database_identity
queries.sql: SELECT DB_NAME() AS database_name, @@SERVERNAME AS server_name;

queries.name: expected_tables_presence
queries.sql:
WITH expected(table_name) AS (
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Plantillas' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_PlantillasDetalle' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Resultados' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Mermas' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Costeo' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_ConfigContable' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_LotesProveedorRendimiento' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_ReclamosProveedor' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_LonjasDisponibles' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Inventario_Movimientos' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Inventario_MovimientosDetalle' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Inventario_Existencias' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Inventario_TipoMovimiento' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Operaciones_Tablaje_EventosContables'
)
SELECT
    expected.table_name,
    CASE
        WHEN objects.object_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
        ELSE 'PRESENT'
    END AS status
FROM expected
LEFT JOIN sys.objects AS objects
    ON objects.name = expected.table_name
   AND objects.type = 'U'
ORDER BY expected.table_name;

queries.name: critical_column_presence
queries.sql:
WITH expected(table_name, column_name) AS (
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'EmpresaID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'UnidadNegocioID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'ServerID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'FechaOperacion' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'OrdenID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'Estatus' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Ordenes', 'UsuarioID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'OrdenID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'ProductoID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'InsumoID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'DerivadoID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'Cantidad' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'PesoKg' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'Piezas' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_OrdenesDetalle', 'PorcentajeEsperado' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Mermas', 'OrdenID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Mermas', 'MermaKg' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Mermas', 'MermaLt' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Costeo', 'OrdenID' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Costeo', 'CostoUnitario' UNION ALL
    SELECT 'Tablajeria_Costeo', 'CostoTotal'
)
SELECT
    expected.table_name,
    expected.column_name,
    CASE
        WHEN columns.column_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
        ELSE 'PRESENT'
    END AS status
FROM expected
LEFT JOIN sys.tables AS tables
    ON tables.name = expected.table_name
LEFT JOIN sys.columns AS columns
    ON columns.object_id = tables.object_id
   AND columns.name = expected.column_name
ORDER BY expected.table_name, expected.column_name;

queries.name: tablajeria_physical_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    schemas.name AS schema_name,
    tables.name AS table_name,
    columns.name AS column_name,
    types.name AS data_type,
    columns.is_nullable
FROM sys.tables AS tables
JOIN sys.schemas AS schemas
    ON schemas.schema_id = tables.schema_id
JOIN sys.columns AS columns
    ON columns.object_id = tables.object_id
JOIN sys.types AS types
    ON types.user_type_id = columns.user_type_id
WHERE
    tables.name LIKE 'Tablajeria_%'
    OR tables.name IN (
        'Inventario_Movimientos',
        'Inventario_MovimientosDetalle',
        'Inventario_Existencias',
        'Inventario_TipoMovimiento',
        'Operaciones_Tablaje_EventosContables'
    )
ORDER BY tables.name, columns.column_id;
